css-inlining.method: Hand-rolled: import route CSS with Vite `?inline`, render React 19 <style href precedence> (hoisted into <head>)

font-optimization.method: @fontsource-variable/geist imported in styles.css (self-hosted, font-display: swap) + hand-added <link rel=preload as=font> via `?url`
font-optimization.note: preload link is hand-written; Fontsource only supplies files + @font-face

image-pipeline.method: vite-imagetools (build-time resize to 200/400/800w, webp/avif, `as=srcset`) + plain

caching.method: waku-cache 0.0.2 (separate wakujs-org package) cache.fn with memoryStore, 4s TTL, cache.invalidate from a 'use server' action
caching.note: needs `pnpm add waku-cache` (v0.0.x, outside waku core; 0.0.2 needs waku>=rc.4). Side finding: on Node 26 every src/pages/_api route throws 'TypeError: Illegal invocation' (undici Request duplex brand check in handleHttpRequest; seen on waku rc.0, not rechecked on rc.5), so invalidation uses a server action

route-prefetching.method: useRouter().prefetch() on hover (stable) + <Link unstable_prefetchOnView> (experimental prop) from waku/router/client
route-prefetching.note: stable path is useRouter().prefetch() wired by hand to onMouseEnter; Link's automatic prefetch props are unstable_

islands.method: RSC server component (no client JS) + 'use client' counter island + <Slice id lazy> dynamic slice on a static page

reactivity.method: @preact/signals-react signal passed directly into JSX; useState counter as control

bundle-analysis.method: rollup-plugin-visualizer added to waku.config.ts vite.plugins (client env) when ANALYZE=1

third-party-scripts.method: Hand-rolled: React 19-hoisted <script async> + LazyScript client component injecting after load/requestIdleCallback

multi-host-deployment.method: Built-in adapters auto-selected by env: waku build with none / NETLIFY=1 / VERCEL=1 / CLOUDFLARE=1
